title: I SPONSORED MY HOUSEMAID'S EDUCATION FOR 8 YEARS... SHE MARRIED MY HUSBAND THE DAY I WENT INTO LABOR
description:
This is Folake's story. A Lagos woman sponsored her housemaid's education for eight years. Treated her like family. When she was diagnosed with cervical cancer and thought she'd die, she SUGGESTED her husband marry the maid as second wife. So her sons would have someone they knew. Someone she trained. The wedding happened while Folake was in labor with her fourth child. But here's the twist: Folake survived. Five years cancer-free. Now she lives with her husband's second wife. The girl she raised. Who has his daughter. Who he loves differently. Folake arranged her own replacement. And now she has to live with it. This is about Nigerian polygamy. About impossible choices. About cancer survival. About kindness becoming a weapon. Subscribe. Comment: Would you suggest your husband marry someone else if you thought you were dying? Share if you've lived in a polygamous home.

title: How to Install a SIM Card to Xiaomi 17T Pro
description:
How to Install a SIM Card on Xiaomi 17T Pro

Installing a SIM card on the Xiaomi 17T Pro allows you to connect to your mobile carrier's network for calls, text messages, and mobile data services. The device supports Nano-SIM cards, and depending on your model and region, it may support Dual SIM functionality, allowing you to use two Nano-SIM cards simultaneously.

Before starting, make sure you have a compatible Nano-SIM card and the SIM eject tool that came with your Xiaomi 17T Pro.

Prepare the Device

⮕ Save any ongoing work and turn off your Xiaomi 17T Pro.

⮕ Although SIM cards can often be inserted while the phone is powered on, turning the device off helps prevent potential detection issues.

⮕ Place the phone on a clean, flat surface to avoid accidental drops or scratches.

Locate the SIM Tray

⮕ Examine the edges of your Xiaomi 17T Pro.

⮕ Locate the SIM card tray, which is typically positioned along the bottom edge of the device near the USB-C charging port.

⮕ You will notice a small pinhole next to the tray.

Remove the SIM Tray

⮕ Insert the SIM eject tool into the small pinhole.

⮕ Apply gentle pressure until the SIM tray pops out slightly.

⮕ Carefully pull the tray out of the phone.

⮕ Avoid using excessive force to prevent damage to the tray or eject mechanism.

Insert the SIM Card

⮕ Place the Nano-SIM card into the designated SIM slot on the tray.

⮕ Align the notched corner of the SIM card with the matching corner of the tray.

⮕ Ensure the SIM card sits flat and securely in position.

⮕ If your model supports Dual SIM, place the second Nano-SIM card into the remaining slot using the same alignment method.

Check SIM Card Alignment

⮕ Verify that each SIM card is properly seated within the tray.

⮕ Make sure the cards do not protrude from the tray edges.

⮕ Incorrect alignment may prevent the tray from sliding back into the device properly.

Reinsert the SIM Tray

⮕ Carefully slide the tray back into the phone.

⮕ Keep the tray aligned with the slot during insertion.

⮕ Push gently until the tray is fully seated and flush with the edge of the device.

⮕ Do not force the tray if resistance is encountered.

Turn On the Device

⮕ Press and hold the Power button until the Xiaomi logo appears.

⮕ Wait for the phone to complete the startup process.

⮕ The device should automatically detect the installed SIM card.

Verify SIM Card Detection

⮕ Open the Settings application.

⮕ Tap SIM Cards & Mobile Networks.

⮕ Confirm that your carrier information appears correctly.

⮕ If two SIM cards are installed, verify that both are detected and configured properly.

Configure Mobile Network Settings

⮕ In the SIM Cards & Mobile Networks section, select your preferred SIM for:

⮕ Mobile Data

⮕ Voice Calls

⮕ SMS Messages

⮕ Adjust any additional network settings according to your carrier requirements.

Your SIM card is now successfully installed in the Xiaomi 17T Pro. You can begin making calls, sending messages, and using mobile data once the device connects to your carrier's network.

title: How to Enable and use Quick Ball on Xiaomi 17T Pro
description:
How to Enable and Use Quick Ball on Xiaomi 17T Pro

Quick Ball is a convenient floating shortcut feature available on the Xiaomi 17T Pro. It adds a movable on-screen button that provides quick access to frequently used functions such as Back, Home, Recent Apps, Screenshot, Flashlight, Lock Screen, and more. Quick Ball can help improve one-handed operation and reduce the need to use physical buttons.

Open Settings

⮕ Unlock your Xiaomi 17T Pro and open the Settings application.

⮕ Scroll down and tap Additional Settings.

⮕ Locate the Quick Ball option in the menu.

⮕ Tap Quick Ball to access its settings.

Enable Quick Ball

⮕ Turn on the Use Quick Ball or Turn On Quick Ball toggle.

⮕ A small floating button will immediately appear on the edge of the screen.

⮕ You can drag the button to any position that feels comfortable.

Open the Quick Ball Menu

⮕ Tap the floating Quick Ball icon.

⮕ A shortcut panel will expand on the screen.

⮕ By default, several commonly used shortcuts may already be available.

⮕ Tap any shortcut to perform its assigned action instantly.

Customize Quick Ball Shortcuts

⮕ Return to Quick Ball settings.

⮕ Tap Select Shortcuts.

⮕ Choose any shortcut slot that you want to modify.

⮕ Select a new function from the available list.

⮕ You can assign actions such as:

⮕ Back

⮕ Home

⮕ Recent Apps

⮕ Screenshot

⮕ Flashlight

⮕ Lock Screen

⮕ Silent Mode

⮕ One-Handed Mode

⮕ Open a Specific App

⮕ Save your changes when finished.

Change the Activation Method

⮕ Open Quick Ball settings.

⮕ Locate Preferred Gesture.

⮕ Choose between Tap and Swipe activation methods.

⮕ Select the option that feels most comfortable for your daily use.

Adjust Quick Ball Behavior

⮕ In the Quick Ball settings menu, explore the additional customization options.

⮕ Enable Hide Automatically if you want the button to disappear in selected apps.

⮕ Enable Hide in Full Screen Mode to prevent the button from interfering with videos and games.

⮕ Turn on Stick to Edge so the button automatically moves to the screen edge after inactivity.

⮕ Enable Show on Lock Screen if you want access to Quick Ball before unlocking the device.

Move the Quick Ball

⮕ Press and hold the floating Quick Ball button.

⮕ Drag it to a new location on the screen.

⮕ Release your finger when the button reaches the desired position.

⮕ The button can be placed on either side of the display for easier access.

Use Quick Ball During Daily Tasks

⮕ Tap the Quick Ball whenever you need fast access to a shortcut.

⮕ Use it to take screenshots without pressing hardware buttons.

⮕ Open Recent Apps for multitasking.

⮕ Lock the screen instantly.

⮕ Launch your favorite applications with a single tap.

⮕ Access common functions without navigating through multiple menus.

Quick Ball is now enabled and ready to use on your Xiaomi 17T Pro. With customized shortcuts and quick access controls, you can navigate your device more efficiently and perform everyday actions with fewer taps.

title: How to Turn Off Xiaomi 17T Pro
description:
How to Turn Off Xiaomi 17T Pro

There are several ways to power off your Xiaomi 17T Pro. You can use the physical Power button, the Quick Settings panel, or accessibility shortcuts depending on your device settings. Turning off your phone completely can help conserve battery life, troubleshoot software issues, or prepare the device for storage or transport.

Method 1: Turn Off Using the Power Button

⮕ Press and hold the Power button located on the side of the device.

⮕ Continue holding the button until the Power Menu appears on the screen.

⮕ Tap Power Off.

⮕ Confirm the action if prompted.

⮕ Wait a few seconds while the device shuts down completely.

Method 2: Turn Off Using Power and Volume Up Buttons

⮕ If pressing the Power button launches Google Gemini or another assistant instead of the Power Menu, press and hold the Power button and Volume Up button simultaneously.

⮕ Hold both buttons for a few seconds.

⮕ When the Power Menu appears, tap Power Off.

⮕ The phone will begin the shutdown process.

Method 3: Turn Off from Control Center

⮕ Swipe down from the top-right corner of the screen to open Control Center.

⮕ Look for the Power icon near the top of the panel.

⮕ Tap the Power icon.

⮕ Select Power Off from the available options.

⮕ Confirm if required.

Method 4: Turn Off Using Accessibility Menu

⮕ If Accessibility Menu is enabled, open the Accessibility Menu shortcut.

⮕ Tap the Power option.

⮕ Select Power Off.

⮕ Confirm the shutdown request.

How to Turn the Phone Back On

⮕ Press and hold the Power button.

⮕ Keep holding until the Xiaomi logo appears.

⮕ Release the button and wait for the device to boot normally.

Customize the Power Button Behavior

⮕ Open Settings.

⮕ Tap Additional Settings.

⮕ Select Gesture Shortcuts.

⮕ Open Press and Hold the Power Button.

⮕ Choose whether the Power button launches the voice assistant or displays the Power Menu.

⮕ Adjusting this setting can make it easier to access the shutdown menu in the future.

Your Xiaomi 17T Pro is now powered off. You can use any of the available methods whenever you need to shut down the device completely.

title: How to customize Keyboard on Xiaomi 17T Pro
description:
How to Customize Keyboard on Xiaomi 17T Pro

The Xiaomi 17T Pro typically uses Gboard as its default keyboard. Gboard offers a wide range of customization options, including themes, keyboard size, key borders, languages, sound effects, vibration feedback, and typing preferences. Customizing these settings can improve both the appearance and usability of your keyboard.

Open Keyboard Settings

⮕ Open any application that allows text input, such as Messages, Notes, or Chrome.

⮕ Tap a text field to make the keyboard appear.

⮕ Tap the Settings (gear) icon on the keyboard.

⮕ If you do not see the gear icon, tap the four-dot menu and select Settings.

⮕ The Gboard settings menu will open.

Change the Keyboard Theme

⮕ In Gboard Settings, tap Theme.

⮕ Browse through the available color themes, gradients, and dark mode options.

⮕ You can also select a custom photo from your gallery as the keyboard background.

⮕ Enable or disable Key Borders according to your preference.

⮕ Tap Apply to save the new keyboard appearance.

Resize the Keyboard

⮕ Open the keyboard in any app.

⮕ Tap the four-dot menu located on the keyboard toolbar.

⮕ Select Resize.

⮕ Drag the adjustment handles to increase or decrease the keyboard height.

⮕ Tap the checkmark to save the new size.

⮕ A larger keyboard may improve typing accuracy, while a smaller keyboard leaves more room on the screen.

Customize Key Press Feedback

⮕ Open Gboard Settings.

⮕ Tap Preferences.

⮕ Scroll to the Key Press section.

⮕ Enable or disable:

⮕ Sound on Keypress

⮕ Haptic Feedback on Keypress

⮕ Popup on Keypress

⮕ Adjust vibration strength and sound volume if desired.

⮕ These settings allow you to personalize how the keyboard feels while typing.

Change Keyboard Languages

⮕ In Gboard Settings, tap Languages.

⮕ Select Add Keyboard.

⮕ Choose the language you want to use.

⮕ Select your preferred keyboard layout.

⮕ Tap Done to add the language.

⮕ You can switch between languages directly from the keyboard when typing.

Customize Typing Preferences

⮕ Open Preferences within Gboard Settings.

⮕ Configure options such as:

⮕ Auto-Capitalization

⮕ Auto-Correction

⮕ Spell Check

⮕ Emoji Suggestions

⮕ Number Row

⮕ Long Press for Symbols

⮕ These settings help tailor the typing experience to your personal preferences.

Enable One-Handed Mode

⮕ Open the keyboard.

⮕ Tap the four-dot menu.

⮕ Select One-Handed Mode.

⮕ Choose the left or right side of the screen.

⮕ Adjust the keyboard size if needed.

⮕ This feature makes typing easier when using the phone with one hand.

Switch to a Different Keyboard

⮕ Open Settings.

⮕ Navigate to Additional Settings.

⮕ Tap Languages & Input.

⮕ Select Manage Keyboards.

⮕ Enable another installed keyboard if desired.

⮕ You can then choose which keyboard you want to use as the default input method.

Your keyboard on the Xiaomi 17T Pro is now customized. You can continue adjusting themes, size, languages, and typing preferences at any time to create a keyboard experience that best matches your style and workflow.

The SDA 2026 awards ceremony is set to take place on **October 8, 2026, in Seoul, South Korea** — and the entire C-Drama community around the world is already counting down the days. A wandering girl from the streets stumbles into a traditional Chinese medicine clan and is forced to learn under a master. She clashes sharply with the gentle yet aloof young heir at first sight. Conflictos familiares y crisis médicas los separan entre malentendidos y amor secreto. El joven se mantiene fiel a ella a pesar de todos los obstáculos. Se curan mutuamente entre aromas de hierbas; su amor contenido pero apasionado conmueve el corazón, una mezcla adictiva de dulzura y melancolía.
